use vstd::prelude::*;

verus! {

pub const LIMIT: u32 = 7;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: u32,
    pub y: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash, Default)]
pub enum Kind {
    #[default]
    A,
    B { n: u8 },
    C { n: u8 },
}

pub fn limit() -> (r: u32)
    ensures
        r == LIMIT,
{
    LIMIT
}

} // verus!
